verdict.rationale: Mercury Books ships automatic duplicate-bill detection and an AI assistant (Command) that can answer questions and take bookkeeping actions on request, giving partial coverage of anomaly-style monitoring, but there's no evidence of an autonomous agent continuously monitoring the full ledger for spend anomalies or flagging issues proactively before close — the promised MCP/agent automation layer is explicitly future ("soon"), and Mercury itself cautions the system isn't "on autopilot." Missing for 10: proactive continuous anomaly/duplicate-spend flagging across the whole ledger (not just bill pay), shipped agent/MCP automation rather than roadmap claims, and any multi-entity audit capability.
